tool.description: The tool Gentry was set up for, such as claude.

dir.description: Directory of the integration files built for the tool.

plugin_version.description: Version of the built plugin; it changes whenever the plugin content does.

action.description: What happened in the tool: installed, updated, unchanged or switched (the plugin was served from another directory, see previous_dir). The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

previous_dir.description: Directory the tool served the plugin from before it was switched to dir; only with the action switched.

enabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled in the tool; Gentry does not enable a plugin the operator disabled.

permission.description: The rule that allows the tools of Gentry in the user settings of the tool: added, present (the settings had it) or failed (the settings cannot be read and are left as they are). The list is open: a client shows an unknown value as is.

settings.description: The file of the user settings of the tool the rule is in.
